groups.reason: Duden derives documentary Akte from plural Akten and Latin acta; Personalakte and Krankenakte independently establish the documentary compound sense. Each frozen existing source record denotes a case, personnel, medical, judicial, security or archival file, not a performed act or a substring match. Accept exactly these documentary Akte/Akten components; preserve the rest of each compound and grant no general akt/akte suffix rule. Ambiguous legal acts, artistic acts, malformed tokens, redakteur and akteur remain outside this decision.

limitations: Finite manually inspected lexical identities only; other suffix-like candidates remain unreviewed.
Does not promote a new family, canonical realization or whole-compound identity.
Legal acts, nude-art Akt, theatrical acts, geographic names and OCR damage require separate sense review.
